entries.Original: Error saving config, is something else writing to it?
entries.Translated: 保存错误配置，还有其他内容要写入吗？

entries.Original: QoL Bar has a new feature where categories may now run commands like a normal shortcut, this may cause problems for people who were using the plugin BEFORE JANUARY 4TH, due to the command setting being used for tooltips. Please verify that you understand the risks and that YOU MAY ACCIDENTALLY SEND CHAT MESSAGES WHEN CLICKING CATEGORIES. Additionally, YOU MAY DELETE ALL COMMANDS FROM ALL CATEGORIES AFTERWARDS if you are worried. Selecting YES will remove EVERY command from EVERY category in your config, note that this has no real downside if you have not started to utilize this feature. Selecting NO will close this popup permanently, you may also change your mind after selecting YES if you restore the version backup from the config, please be aware that old configs will possibly contain commands again if you do reload one of them.
entries.Translated: QoL Bar 新增了一个功能，其中类别现在可以像普通快捷方式一样运行命令，这可能会给在 1 月 4 日之前使用插件的人带来问题，因为命令设置被用于工具提示。请确认您理解其中的风险，并且您可能会在点击类别时意外发送聊天消息。此外，如果您担心，可以在之后从所有类别中删除所有命令。选择 “是” 将从您的配置中的 “所有” 类别中删除 “所有” 命令，请注意，如果您还没有开始使用这个功能，这并没有真正的负面影响。选择 NO 将永久关闭此弹出窗口，如果您从配置恢复版本备份，在选择 YES 后也可能会改变主意。请注意，如果您重新加载其中一个旧配置，它们可能会再次包含命令。

entries.Original: Invalid macro. Usage: "//m0" for individual macro #0, "//m100" for shared macro #0, valid up to 199.
entries.Translated: 无效宏。用法：单个宏 #0 使用 “//m0”，共享宏 #0 使用 “//m100”，最高有效为 199。

entries.Original: Macros do not support item usage.
Failed to add command to macro, capacity reached. Please close off the macro with another "//m" if you didn't intend to do this.
entries.Translated: 未能向宏添加命令，容量已达到。如果您不打算这样做，请使用另一个 “//m” 关闭宏。

entries.Original: Macros using more than 15 lines do not support chat message commands!
entries.Translated: 使用超过 15 行的宏不支持聊天消息命令！

entries.Original: Failed to import from clipboard! Import string is invalid or incomplete.
entries.Translated: 从剪贴板导入失败！导入字符串无效或不完整。

entries.Original: Failed to import from clipboard! Import string does not contain an importable object.
entries.Translated: 从剪贴板导入失败！导入字符串不包含可导入的对象。

entries.Original: This import contained {0} automatically removed, please enable "{1}" inside the "Settings" tab on the plugin config and then try importing again if you did not intend to do this.
entries.Translated: 此导入包含{0}自动删除，请在插件配置的 “设置” 选项卡中启用 “{1}”，然后如果您不打算这样做，请再次尝试导入。

entries.Original: one or more hotkeys that were
It appears that this bar was meant to be used as a pie. You should add a hotkey to it by right clicking on the bar and clicking the "Pie Hotkey" input box.
entries.Translated: 看来这个栏目是用作馅饼的。您应该通过右键点击栏目并点击 “馅饼热键” 输入框来添加热键。

entries.Original: Press escape to clear the hotkey.
Disables the hotkey from blocking the game input.
entries.Translated: 禁用热键阻止游戏输入。

entries.Original:
Add a new shortcut.
Right click this (or the bar background) for options.
Right click other shortcuts to edit them.
entries.Translated:
添加新的快捷方式。
右键点击此 (或条形背景) 查看选项。
右键点击其他快捷键以编辑它们。

entries.Original:
Export to clipboard with minimal settings (May change with updates).
Right click to export with every setting (Longer string, doesn't change).
entries.Translated:
导出至剪贴板，设置最小 (可能随更新而变化)。
右键单击导出每个设置 (较长字符串，不变)。

entries.Original: Please enable the "Allow exporting sensitive condition sets" setting to export this set.
entries.Translated: 请启用 “允许导出敏感条件集” 设置以导出此集。
导出条件设置为剪贴板。

entries.Original: Failed to import condition set from clipboard!
entries.Translated: 未能从剪贴板导入条件设置！
从剪贴板设定导入条件。

entries.Original:
Double click on a set to edit its name.

Additionally, you can click this to open Dalamud's debug menu
to see current Condition Flags.
entries.Translated:
双击集合以编辑其名称。

此外，您可以点击此按钮打开 Dalamud 的调试菜单。
查看当前条件标志。

entries.Original: Right click this button to delete this condition!
entries.Translated: 右键点击此按钮删除此条件！

entries.Original:
Icons accept arguments between "::" and their ID. I.e. "::f21".
	' f ' - Applies the hotbar frame.
	' n ' - Removes the hotbar frame.
	' l ' - Uses the low resolution icon.
	' h ' - Uses the high resolution icon if it exists.
	' g ' - Changes the icon to grayscale.
	' r ' - Reverses the icon.
entries.Translated:
图标接受 “::” 和其 ID 之间的参数。即 “::f21”。
f - 应用热条框架。
n - 移除热条框架。
L——使用低分辨率图标。
h - 如果存在高分辨率图标，请使用它。
g——将图标更改为灰度。
“r”——反转图标。

entries.Original:
You can use right click to add special game symbols, additionally,
there are custom commands that only work from shortcuts.
	' //m0 ' - Executes individual macro #0 (up to //m99).
	' //m100 ' - Executes shared macro #0 (up to //m199).
	' //m ' - Begins or ends a custom macro. The following lines
will execute as a macro instead of a shortcut (allowing for
/wait, /macrolock, etc), until //m is used again, up to 30 lines.
	' //i <ID/Name> ' - Uses an item, cannot be used with //m.
	' // <Comment> ' - Adds a comment.

Changes the behavior when pressed.
Note: Not intended to be used with categories containing subcategories.
entries.Translated:
更改按下时的行为。
注：不适用于包含子类别的类别。

entries.Original: Default behavior, categories must be set to this to edit their shortcuts!
entries.Translated: 默认行为，类别必须设置为这个才能编辑其快捷方式！

entries.Original: Executes each line/shortcut in order over multiple presses.
entries.Translated: 在多个按键上按顺序执行每一行/快捷键。

entries.Original: Executes a random line/shortcut when pressed.
entries.Translated: 按下时执行随机行/快捷键。

entries.Original: Set to 0 to use text width.
entries.Translated: 设置为 0 以使用文本宽度。

entries.Original:
Number of shortcuts in each row before starting another.
Set to 0 to specify infinite.
entries.Translated:
在开始另一行之前，每行的快捷方式数量。
设置为 0 以指定无限。

entries.Original:
Keeps the category open when pressing shortcuts within it.
May not work if the shortcut interacts with other plugins.
entries.Translated:
在其中按下快捷键时保持类别打开。
如果快捷方式与其他插件交互，可能无法正常工作。

entries.Original:
WARNING: This will prevent you from interacting with this bar.
To edit the settings again, you will need to use the "O" button
next to the bar's name inside the general config.
entries.Translated:
警告：这将阻止你与这个条形图进行互动。
要再次编辑设置，您需要使用 “O” 按钮。
在通用配置中的条形码名称旁边。

entries.Original: Will prevent the bar from sleeping, increasing CPU load.
entries.Translated: 这将防止酒吧睡眠，增加 CPU 负载。

entries.Original:
Place images inside "%AppData%\XIVLauncher\pluginConfigs\QoLBar\icons"
to load them as usable icons, the file names must be in the format "#.img" (# > 0).
I.e. "1.jpg" "2.png" "3.png" "732487.jpg" and so on.
entries.Translated:
将图像放入 “%AppData%\XIVLauncher\pluginConfigs\QoLBar\icons” 中
要将它们加载为可用图标，文件名必须采用 “#.img” 格式 (# > 0)。
即 “1.jpg”“2.png”“3.png”“732487.jpg” 等。

entries.Original:
Applies a condition set to the bar that will control when it is shown.
Useful for making groups of bars that all display at the same time.
You can make these on the "Condition Sets" tab at the top of this window.
entries.Translated:
将设定的条件应用于条形，以控制其何时显示。
用于创建同时显示所有条形图的组合。
您可以在此窗口顶部的 “条件设置” 选项卡中执行这些操作。

entries.Original: Right click this button to delete bar #
entries.Translated: 右键点击此按钮以删除 # 栏

entries.Original: The bar will be exported to clipboard first.
entries.Translated: 条将首先导出到剪贴板。

entries.Original:
Import a bar from the clipboard, or import a single shortcut as a new bar.
Right click will add a demo bar that showcases various features.
entries.Translated:
从剪贴板导入一个条形图，或者将单个快捷键作为新条形图导入。
右键点击将添加一个展示各种功能的演示栏。

entries.Original: Bars will remain visible even when logged out.
entries.Translated: 即使退出登录，条形图仍然可见。

entries.Original:
Loads the high resolution icons instead. Be aware that the Icon Browser will use
up to 5GB of memory until closed if you open the "Spoilers" tabs!
entries.Translated:
加载高分辨率图标。请注意，图标浏览器将使用
如果您打开 “剧透” 选项卡，最多可达 5GB 内存，直到关闭！

entries.Original: Disables the 100ms delay between checking conditions, increasing CPU load.
entries.Translated: 禁用检查条件之间的 100 毫秒延迟，增加 CPU 负载。

entries.Original: Number of minutes since the last save to perform a backup. Set to 0 to disable.
entries.Translated: 自上次保存备份以来的分钟数。将其设置为 0 以禁用。

entries.Original: Opt out of Dalamud settings for hiding UI
entries.Translated: 选择退出 Dalamud 设置以隐藏 UI

entries.Original: Temporary settings, ENABLE AT OWN RISK
entries.Translated: 临时设置，在自有风险下启用

entries.Original: Allows exporting condition sets that contain personal information, such as your character ID.
entries.Translated: 允许导出包含个人信息的条件集，例如您的角色 ID。

entries.Original: Double click this button to overwrite and
Double right click this button to delete

entries.Translated: UI 模块 (活动文本输入)
上下文菜单项 代理

entries.Original: Right click this button to delete the shortcut!
entries.Translated: 右键点击此按钮删除快捷方式！

entries.Original: The shortcut will be exported to clipboard first.
entries.Translated: 快捷方式将首先导出到剪贴板。

entries.Original:
Opens up a list of all icons you can use instead of text.
Warning: The last 3 tabs contain very large images and will use several GB of memory.
Clicking on one will copy text to be pasted into the "Name" field of a shortcut.
Additionally, while the browser is open it will autofill the "Name" of shortcuts.
entries.Translated:
打开所有可以用来代替文本的图标列表。
警告：最后 3 个选项卡包含非常大的图像，将占用数 GB 的内存。
点击其中一个将拷贝文本并粘贴到快捷指令的 “名称” 栏中。
此外，当浏览器打开时，它会自动填充快捷方式的 “名称”。

entries.Original:
Import a shortcut from the clipboard,
or import all of another bar's shortcuts.
entries.Translated:
从剪贴板导入快捷指令
或者导入另一个条形码的所有快捷方式。

entries.Original: Warning: this will always be true!

Timespan should be formatted as "XX:XX-XX:XX" (24h) and may contain "X" wildcards.
I.e "XX:30-XX:10" will return true for times such as 01:30, 13:54, and 21:09.
The minimum time is inclusive, but the maximum is not.
entries.Translated:
时间跨度应格式化为 “XX:XX-XX:XX”(24 小时)，并可能包含 “X” 通配符。
即 “XX:30-XX:10” 将在 01:30、13:54 和 21:09 等时间返回真值。
最小时间是包含的，但最大时间不是。

entries.Original:
See "/xldata ai" to find the names of various windows.
Right click to set this to the currently focused UI addon's name.
entries.Translated:
请参阅 “/xldata ai” 以查找各种窗口的名称。
右键单击将此设置为当前聚焦的 UI 插件名称。

entries.Original: Selecting this will assign the current character's ID to this condition.
entries.Translated: 选择此选项将为此条件分配当前字符的 ID。

entries.Original:
If this condition has no data when imported,
it will automatically be assigned.
entries.Translated:
如果这个条件在导入时没有数据，
它将自动被分配。

entries.Original: This will only return true if the party member exists in the current area.
entries.Translated: 这只有在当前区域存在党员时才会返回 true。

entries.Original: This refers to areas that accumulate rested experience.
entries.Translated: 这指的是积累休息经验的区域。
所有当前活跃状态标志
条件标志处于活动状态

entries.Original: Not in most content, cutscenes, or loading
entries.Translated: 不在大多数内容、过场动画或加载中
